text:
Plate spans about 355 px across (roughly 207 to 562). If it is a dinner plate of about 26 cm, that is about 0.073 cm per px.

The pizza slice is a wedge about 230 px wide and 180 px tall, so roughly 17 cm by 13 cm. A wedge covers about half of that rectangle, which comes to about 110 cm². At a thickness of about 1.5 cm, that is roughly 165 cm³. Pizza crust is airy, with a density of about 0.45 g/cm³, so the slice weighs about 80–100 g. I'll use 95 g.

The toppings are small:
- Arugula: a few leaves, about 4 g.
- Mozzarella or ricotta dollops: about 15 g.
- Roasted squash or pumpkin pieces: about 20 g. These may be partly included in the slice weight, so I'll keep this modest.
- Tomato sauce: it is already part of the slice, so I won't list it separately.
